title.zh: Dynamics 365 ERP MCP 与 Work IQ 智能体底座架构（THR885）
title.en: Dynamics 365 ERP MCP & Work IQ Agentic Foundation Architecture (THR885)

label.zh: 1. 智能体客户端与运行宿主层（Client Harnesses: Copilot Studio · Cowork · Pro-Code）
label.en: 1. Agent Client Harnesses (Copilot Studio · Copilot Cowork · VS Code & Third-Party)

label.zh: 2. Work IQ 与远程 MCP 路由层（Read-Only Ask · 650K Operations · Custom Configs）
label.en: 2. Work IQ & Remote MCP Routing Plane (Read-Only Ask · 650K Ops · MCP Configs)

label.zh: 3. Dynamics 365 F&O 业务上下文与内核安全层（10.0.51 Dual-ID Security · Skills · AOT）
label.en: 3. Dynamics 365 F&O Context & Security Kernel (10.0.51 Dual-ID · Skills · Logic)

label.zh: Copilot Studio 自定义业务智能体

detail.zh: 挂载 Work IQ 或直连 ERP MCP 工具，编排跨财务与供应链的自动化业务流
detail.en: Adds Work IQ or direct ERP MCP tools to orchestrate finance and SCM workflows

label.zh: Copilot Cowork 与 M365 Copilot Chat

detail.zh: Cowork 同时支持问答与行动执行；Copilot Chat 当前仅开放只读问答检索
detail.en: Cowork supports both Ask and Do Action; M365 Copilot Chat currently scopes to Q&A

label.zh: VS Code GitHub Copilot 与第三方客户端
label.en: GitHub Copilot in VS Code & 3P Clients

detail.zh: Claude 等外部宿主通过远程连接接入 Work IQ MCP 服务共享同一套业务上下文
detail.en: External harnesses like Claude connect remotely to the Work IQ MCP endpoint

label.zh: Work IQ Ask：42 个高频实体只读检索

detail.zh: 基于 Dataverse 搜索与 ACS 索引提供毫秒级自然语言全文问答与快速数据核验
detail.en: Fast full-text Q&A powered by Dataverse search and ACS over top 42 F&O entities

label.zh: Work IQ Do Action + ERP MCP（65 万项操作）
label.en: Work IQ Do Action + ERP MCP (650K Ops)

detail.zh: 超越增删改查：基于视图模型驱动表单交互、点击按钮执行逻辑并返回记录深链
detail.en: Beyond CRUD: drives form interactions, button clicks, deep links, and attachments

label.zh: MCP 多套可调配置与附件资源下载

detail.zh: 告别硬编码上限：按场景自定义阈值配置，减少工具调用轮次并拉取附件入上下文
detail.en: Scenario-specific thresholds cutting tool-call roundtrips plus resource downloads

label.zh: 10.0.51 双身份内核安全裁剪（User + Agent ID）

detail.zh: 同时校验用户与智能体标识，支持派生删减版角色（如 AR Clerk - Agent）降权运行
detail.en: Evaluates User ID + Agent/App ID so users do less via agents than in the full UI

label.zh: Business Skills（AOT 内置节点与自定义技能）

detail.zh: 遵循 Agent Skills 规范保存在 F&O 内，按安全角色跨所有客户端宿主一致共享
detail.en: Stored in F&O via Agent Skills spec; shared by security role across every harness

label.zh: AI Descriptions 元数据增强与 X++ 业务逻辑

detail.zh: 在表单、实体和字段标签提示之外补充对象语义说明，消除晦涩数据模型歧义
detail.en: Augments cryptic F&O forms, entities, and columns alongside core X++ logic
